# challenge

Work on what follows from taking these commitments up. You see their authored commitment field without the associated body. Say when that view is insufficient; do not infer that unexposed material never existed.

## Original problem (task)
[08f2a17913147174] (h005.task.v1)
What happens to information about the physical state of matter that forms a black hole when the black hole evaporates?
